title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Diligently Studying and Correctly Implementing the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Studying and Correctly Implementing the Securities Law of the PRC

Fa Fa [1999] No. 19

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Division of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Securities Law of the PRC (hereinafter referred to as the Securities Law) will come into force on July 1, 1999. In order to ensure the uniform and correct implementation of the Securities Law, notice is hereby given as follows:

1. Fully recognize the significant importance of the implementation of the Securities Law. The Securities Law is an important law for strengthening supervision, regulating securities issuance and trading, and effectively protecting the legitimate rights and interests of investors. Its implementation represents a major milestone in the legal construction of our country's securities market, and will certainly be conducive to deepening financial reform, rectifying financial order, preventing and defusing financial risks, ensuring the safe, efficient, and healthy operation of the securities market, and securing the national economic security. The implementation of the Securities Law provides a clearer and more uniform legal basis for the people's courts to adjudicate securities dispute cases impartially, to give full play to the function of adjudication, and to promote economic reform and development.

2. Attach high importance to and carefully organize the study of the Securities Law. The people's courts at all levels and the Supreme People's Court shall regard carefully organizing the study of the Securities Law as an important measure to improve the quality of the judicial team. They shall, in various forms, conduct professional training for judicial personnel, study each chapter and article carefully, deeply comprehend, closely link with the actual work of adjudication, and truly achieve mastery through comprehensive understanding.

3. When hearing securities dispute cases, the people's courts shall uniformly apply the Securities Law to securities conduct occurring after the implementation of the Securities Law. For securities conduct occurring before July 1, 1999, the relevant provisions in effect at the time of the conduct shall apply; where there were no provisions at that time, the relevant provisions of the Securities Law may be applied by reference.

4. The Supreme People's Court will, on the basis of investigation and research, promptly draft judicial interpretations on the application of the Securities Law. In the process of studying and applying the Securities Law, the High People's Courts shall carefully summarize adjudication experience, conduct in-depth investigation and research, pay attention to collecting typical cases and issues concerning the application of law, and promptly report them to our Court.

June 29, 1999
